identificationModule.briefTitle: Absorbed Tumor Dose in Peptide Receptor Radionuclide Therapy with Long-acting Somatostatin Analogues - ATSA Trial
identificationModule.officialTitle: Absorbed Tumor Dose in Peptide Receptor Radionuclide Therapy with Long-acting Somatostatin Analogues - ATSA Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: According to current guidelines, patients have to withhalt long-acting somatostatin analogues (LA-SSA) for 4-6 weeks prior to every 177Lutetium-DOTATATE administration. The primary objective of the study is to investigate the effect of LA-SSA on the absorbed dose in tumor lesions during PRRT.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The study population includes all patients aged over 18 with a neuroendocrine tumor grade I and II and a clinical indication for PRRT. Patients treated for at least three months with LA-SSA are randomized over two interventional arms: one arm where patients discontinue LA-SSA 4-6 weeks before the first PRRT treatment and one arm where patients continue LA-SSA treatment and receive the first PRRT administration within one week after the most recent LA-SSA injection. Patients in the control arm who have not been treated with LA-SSA in the last three months will start PRRT according to standard local protocol.

armGroups.label: Control
armGroups.description: In this arm, patients without any LA-SSA treatment for at least 3 months prior to PRRT are included.

armGroups.label: 2A - LA-SSA injection 4-6 weeks before PRRT
armGroups.description: In this arm, patients on LA-SSA treatment for at least 3 months prior to PRRT are included and will receive the last LA-SSA injection 4-6 weeks before PRRT.

armGroups.label: 2B - LA-SSA injection 1-7 days before PRRT
armGroups.description: In this arm, patients on LA-SSA treatment for at least 3 months prior to PRRT are included and will receive the last LA-SSA injection 4-6 weeks before PRRT.

interventions.name: Somatostatin analog
interventions.description: Timing of LA-SSA injection prior to PRRT (either 4-6 weeks or 1-7 days).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Effect of continued LA-SSA use on the absorbed dose in tumor lesions during PRRT.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Effect of continued LA-SSA use on the absorbed dose in normal tissues during PRRT.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: SPECT/CT after 4h, 24h, and 5-7 days post-injection and blood samples at 2h, 4h, 24h and 5-7 days post-injection

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Effect of continued LA-SSA use on the tumor-to-background ratio.
Effect of continued LA-SSA use on population pharmacokinetic parameters of [177Lu]Lu-HA-DOTATATE.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Blood samples at 2h, 4h, 24h and 5-7 days post-injection

otherOutcomes.timeFrame: At baseline, on the day of PRRT administration, 3 weeks after PRRT
